name: Taco Seasoning
siboNotes: Pure spice blends without garlic or onion powder are generally well-tolerated, but check labels for FODMAP additives.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels carefully - many commercial blends contain garlic and onion powder
Make your own blend using cumin, paprika, chili powder, oregano, and salt
Add garlic-infused oil separately for flavor without FODMAPs
Store homemade blends in airtight containers for maximum potency
alternatives: Homemade blend with cumin, paprika, and oregano
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants from paprika and chili
Good source of iron from various spices
